== Enshrined deity ==
; {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Miyakatsuki Konomi}} (みやの すぐりの このみ)
: Miyakatsuki Konomi was the person who, during the {{ill|Jinshin War|bg|Войната Джиншин|ca|Guerra Jinshin|es|Guerra Jinshin|fa|شورش جینشین|fr|Guerre de Jinshin|id|Pertempuran Jinshin|it|Guerra jinshin|ja|壬申の乱|ko|진신의 난|pl|Zamieszki roku Jinshin|pt|Guerra Jinshin|ru|Смута года Дзинсин|sh|Džinšinski rat|simple|Jinshin War|sl|Džinšinska vojna|su|Perang Jinshin|th|สงครามจินชิน|tr|Jinshin Savaşı|uk|Смута Дзінсін|vi|Chiến tranh Jinshin|zh|壬申之亂|qid=Q2378252}}, was ordered by Prince Ōama ({{ill|Emperor Tenmu|ar|الإمبراطور تيمو|arz|الامبراطور تيمو|azb|تمو|ca|Tenmu|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر تێنمو|cs|Temmu|de|Temmu|eo|Temmu|es|Tenmu Tennō|fa|امپراتور تنمو|fr|Tenmu|hak|Tenmu Thiên-fòng|he|טמו, קיסר יפן|hu|Tenmu japán császár|id|Kaisar Tenmu|it|Tenmu|ja|天武天皇|ka|ტენმუ|ko|덴무 천황|la|Tenmu (imperator)|nl|Tenmu|pl|Tenmu|pt|Tenmu|ru|Император Тэмму|sh|Car Temmu|simple|Emperor Tenmu|sl|Cesar Tenmu|su|Kaisar Temmu|sv|Tenmu|th|จักรพรรดิเท็มมุ|tl|Emperador Temmu|tr|Temmu (imparator)|uk|Імператор Темму|vi|Thiên hoàng Tenmu|yo|Emperor Temmu|zh|天武天皇|zh_min_nan|Tenmu Thian-hông|zh_yue|天武天皇|qid=Q335181}}) to send troops to {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Fuwa Road}} (near {{ill|Fuwa no Seki|ja|不破関|zh|不破關|zh_yue|不破關|qid=Q10868912}}). It is said that by his achievements he became {{ill|Dairyō|ja|大領|qid=Q11441890}} of Fuwa District.
